ml_match.author: HowDevelop
ml_match.prompt_snippet:
Create and render a 15-second motion graphics video introducing TanStack AI. Make it feel like a premium            
  developer-tool launch film produced by Studio1: fast, precise, visually surprising, and polished enough to open a   
  keynote or lead a social campaign.

scenes.voiceover: Stop fighting fragmented workflows and design handoffs that break.
scenes.veo_prompt: Cinematic abstract 3D render of interconnected glowing nodes and sleek modern interface elements in a dark environment.

scenes.voiceover: Deploy reusable components and design tokens directly into your system, keeping every team in sync.
scenes.veo_prompt: Clean, high-fidelity UI shot of a Figma design system dashboard showing component libraries and token management.

scenes.voiceover: Collaborate in real time across teams on a single source of truth.
scenes.veo_prompt: Cinematic close-up of a collaborative Figma canvas with multiple cursors moving in real-time.

scenes.voiceover: Connect your design process today. Visit Figma dot com to get started.
scenes.veo_prompt: Minimalist studio shot of the Figma logo centered on a clean, modern background with subtle geometric accents.
